decisions.reason: A new handle family launched only a year ago still has unresolved prospects, and keeping it in a range made in-house on existing tooling costs little, so the option is worth holding.
The mitred handle family is early in its architect specification cycle and cheap to carry, so it is too soon to judge that its value will not be realized.
The multifunctional handle supports the firm's barrier-free and system strategy, its value is still uncertain, and its carrying cost is low, so keeping the option is justified.
This single lever handle has had little visible traction yet, but there is no negative signal and carrying it costs little, so the option should be kept open.
The 1289 collection won the 2023 German Design Award and has its own web page, which points to favorable resolution and makes it worth further commitment.
A finish option is cheap to keep within the existing bronze finishing capability, and demand for it is still emerging, so dropping it now would forfeit option value.
